obernants.domain: CPU-only bounded synthetic values, well-shaped Mat/Table structures, practical finite dimensions, seed42, Monte Carlo K=0 and2, synthetic2x2 NIST-like text and special-function known points. Host datasets, GPU and external services excluded.
obernants.observation_scope: Actual joins: stats imports builtins::table::{opts,opt}, table::groups, value::Table; mcgate imports stats and Rng; ext_boost/ext_nist import Interp whose registry resolves the same builtins. Invalid adapter example: group equality on NaN does not imply matching hash keys. Another: row-key signed zero canonicalization must agree with numerical sorting equality. Benchmark/calibration or full external dataset results are not inferred from helper tests. Paired ttest length compatibility precedes option parsing; only the minimum cleaned-sample-count check follows options. agg count and numel both count original values, so NaN insertion changes both. iso_date selects date-only formatting only for exactly integral inputs; rounded nonintegral midnight keeps a time-bearing pattern.
obernants.operator: Composition excludes missing-key join pairs even though group summaries include missing groups; excludes 1 from uniform draws; excludes cached-normal state advance; excludes rejection only on p==alpha because stats verdict is strict. Zero-K mcgate cannot claim ok rows. Synthetic helper success excludes no possible failure in unexecuted external data suites.
